question: Which of the following was the main drawback of the Doberiner's triads?

options.text: The elements of a triad have some similarities in their properties.
He arranged three element according to their increasing atomic mass.
He was unable to make more than three triads of the elements.
He found some periodicity in the properties of triads.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He was unable to make more than three triads of the elements.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Johann Wolfgang Döbereiner** was a German chemist who attempted to classify elements into groups of three, known as **triads**.
 
• The main drawback of Döbereiner's triads was that he was **unable to make more than three triads** of the elements.
 
• Döbereiner's triads were an early attempt to classify elements, which later paved the way for the development of the periodic table.
 
• Although his model showed some periodicity in properties, it was limited by the small number of triads he could identify.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Döbereiner's work highlighted the need for a more comprehensive system of classification of elements.
 
• His observations contributed to the development of the periodic law and the modern periodic table.
 
• The periodic table as we know it today was developed by Dmitri Mendeleev, who arranged elements by increasing atomic mass and grouped them based on similar chemical properties.
